For a degree-$d$ polynomial $p_d(A)$ on $|\psi\rangle$, our QET algorithm can achieve optimal $\Theta(d)$ circuit depth and optimal $\mathcal{O}(||p_d||_{\infty}/||p_d(A)|\psi\rangle||)$ post-selection repetitions. LCHM-based QETs unify various quantum linear algebraic problems with near-optimal $\mathcal{\widetilde O}(d\log(d/\epsilon))$ Clifford$+T$ gates, including driven ODEs (reduced to standard LCHS), iterative methods, resolvents, $\log(I+A)$, $(\lambda I+A)^\nu$, Sign and ReLU transforms, and Faber approximation on noncircular domains.
summary:
我们发现了两个互补的埃尔米特矩阵线性组合 (LCHM) 公式来实现一般的非正态矩阵特征值变换 $g(A)$。首先，对于具有埃尔米特 $L$ 和 $H$ 的 $A=L+\mathrm{i} H$，普通 LCHM 公式将 $g(A)$ 表示为 $g(\mathrm{i}(H+kL))$ 的核积分，并且它包含哈密顿模拟的线性组合 (LCHS) [An, Liu, Lin, Phys.莱特牧师。 2023] 作为矩阵指数的特殊情况。其次，对于角埃尔米特方程 $X_\theta = \cos\theta L+\sin\theta H$，Weyl LCHM 公式通过积分 $g(\mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{i}\theta} (X_\theta\pm\mathrm{i}(I-X_\theta^2)^{1/2}))$ 来表示 $g(A)$。对于矩阵幂 $g(A)=A^m$，Weyl LCHM 的傅立叶投影给出 \[ A^m=\frac{2}{\pi}\int_0^\pi \text{e}^{\text{i} m\theta}T_m(X_\theta) \text{d}\theta = \frac{2}{N}\sum_{j=0}^{N-1} \text{e}^{\text{i} m\theta_j}T_m(X_{\theta_j}),\quad\theta_j=\frac{\pi j}{N},\quad \text{对于每 } N>m \] 以及 Hermitian $T_m(X_\theta)$ 和 $N$ 样本的切比雪夫多项式。离散公式是精确的，不会引入截断和角度正交误差，并提供 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 后选择权重。

LCHM 公式催生了新的量子特征值变换 (QET) 算法。对于 $|\psi\rangle$ 上的 $d$ 次多项式 $p_d(A)$，我们的 QET 算法可以实现最佳 $\Theta(d)$ 电路深度和最佳 $\mathcal{O}(||p_d||_{\infty}/||p_d(A)|\psi\rangle||)$ 选择后重复次数。基于 LCHM 的 QET 将各种量子线性代数问题与近乎最优的 $\mathcal{\widetilde O}(d\log(d/\epsilon))$ Clifford$+T$ 门统一起来，包括驱动 ODE（简化为标准 LCHS）、迭代方法、求解器、$\log(I+A)$、$(\lambda I+A)^\nu$、Sign 和 ReLU 变换以及 Faber非圆域上的近似。

title: OmniQEC: discovering practical quantum error-correcting codes by an AI scientist
abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is indispensable for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, discovering QEC codes that remain effective is challenging, as logical performance depends on the interplay between code structure, hardware, syndrome extraction, and decoding, which often impose competing requirements. Here we introduce OmniQEC, an efficient AI scientist for discovering QEC codes suited to deployment on modern quantum processors. OmniQEC formulates QEC design as an iterative discovery process in which an orchestrator, implemented by advanced large language models (LLMs), coordinates code generation, code-level screening, syndrome-extraction synthesis, and decoder-based circuit evaluation. At its core, OmniQEC combines a self-evolving reasoning mechanism with a slow--fast synergistic workflow: a fast loop explores candidates using inexpensive code-level proxies, whereas a slow loop performs physically grounded circuit-level evaluation and feeds the resulting evidence back into the search. We evaluate OmniQEC across four qLDPC construction families, three LLM backends, and $14$ total-physical-qubit budgets per backend. The discovered codes show steadily improving logical-error suppression with increasing physical-qubit budgets and outperform the BB codes with $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ and $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ under complete-implementation budgets of 98 and 240 physical qubits, respectively. The discovered codes are hardware-friendly and may be of independent interest for practical QEC implementation. These findings pave the way towards LLM-assisted QEC discovery grounded in physically informed code--circuit--decoder co-design.
summary:
量子纠错（QEC）对于可扩展的容错量子计算是不可或缺的。然而，发现仍然有效的 QEC 代码具有挑战性，因为逻辑性能取决于代码结构、硬件、校正子提取和解码之间的相互作用，而这通常会提出相互竞争的要求。在这里，我们介绍 OmniQEC，这是一位高效的人工智能科学家，用于发现适合在现代量子处理器上部署的 QEC 代码。 OmniQEC 将 QEC 设计制定为迭代发现过程，其中由高级大语言模型 (LLM) 实现的编排器协调代码生成、代码级筛选、综合症提取综合和基于解码器的电路评估。 OmniQEC 的核心是将自我进化的推理机制与慢速协同工作流程相结合：快速循环使用廉价的代码级代理来探索候选者，而慢速循环则执行物理接地的电路级评估并将结果证据反馈到搜索中。我们通过四个 qLDPC 构建系列、三个 LLM 后端和每个后端 14 美元的总物理量子位预算来评估 OmniQEC。

所发现的代码显示，随着物理量子位预算的增加，逻辑错误抑制能力稳步提高，并且在 98 个和 240 个物理量子位的完整实现预算下分别优于 $[\![72,12,6]\!]$ 和 $[\![144,12,12]\!]$ 的 BB 代码。所发现的代码对硬件友好，并且对于实际的 QEC 实现可能具有独立的意义。这些发现为基于物理信息的代码-电路-解码器协同设计的 LLM 辅助 QEC 发现铺平了道路。

title: Consistent Quantum States over Spacetime without a Common Quantum Process
abstract: Determining whether multiple record-conditioned quantum descriptions admit a single underlying process is a central consistency problem for quantum states over spacetime (QSOSTs) and relational quantum descriptions. Yet causally agnostic interferometry accesses only a lower-dimensional QSOST projection, which inevitably leaves some process degrees of freedom unresolved. We combine branch-resolved QSOST interferometry with positive-process lifting and semidefinite convex duality to characterize this gluing problem. We prove that every positive-weight QSOST branch has a unique least positive lift and reduce both settingwise and common-process realizability to deterministic-process domination. Using this criterion, we construct a minimal bipartite-qubit example with two record settings and two outcomes in the definite causal order $A\prec B$: each setting is separately realizable, and both share the same complete unconditional QSOST, yet no single deterministic process realizes them jointly. The separation has the exact visibility threshold $\eta =1/\sqrt{2}$ , admits a sparse witness involving eight interferometric quadratures, and persists for full-rank processes. These results establish an operational boundary between QSOST consistency and global process consistency, and provide a practical framework for testing whether multiple quantum perspectives can share one standard-quantum process.
summary:
确定多个记录条件量子描述是否承认单个底层过程是时空量子态 (QSOST) 和关系量子描述的中心一致性问题。然而，因果无关的干涉测量法只能访问较低维的 QSOST 投影，这不可避免地会留下一些未解决的过程自由度。我们将分支分辨 QSOST 干涉测量与正过程提升和半定凸对偶性相结合来表征该粘合问题。我们证明每个正权重 QSOST 分支都具有独特的最小正提升，并降低了确定性过程控制的设置和通用过程的可实现性。使用这个标准，我们构建了一个最小的二分量子位示例，具有两个记录设置和两个结果，按明确的因果顺序 $A\prec B$ ：每个设置都是可单独实现的，并且两者共享相同的完整无条件 QSOST，但没有一个确定性过程可以共同实现它们。分离具有精确的可见性阈值 $\eta =1/\sqrt{2}$ ，允许涉及八个干涉正交的稀疏见证，并且对于满秩过程持续存在。

这些结果在 QSOST 一致性和全局过程一致性之间建立了操作边界，并为测试多个量子视角是否可以共享一个标准量子过程提供了一个实用框架。

title: Equi-Entropic Maps for Four-Partite Quantum States
abstract: Absolutely maximally entangled states represent a highly constrained form of multipartite entanglement and play an important role in quantum information theory. We investigate a weaker form of uniformity of entanglement for four-party systems of local dimension $d>2$ that requires the three balanced bipartitions to have equal but not necessarily maximal linear entropy. We introduce a linear map $\Xi$ that enforces exact equality of entropies under reshuffling and partial transposition. The transformation arises as the asymptotic limit of an iterative averaging procedure and admits a group-theoretic description in terms of permutations of tensor indices. For Haar-random unitary inputs, a leading-moment analysis supported by numerical simulations predicts highly entangled outputs whose common entropy approaches the maximal value as the local dimension grows. We characterize the algebraic structure, fixed points, and asymptotic behavior of this map and its relation to two-unitary matrices and orthogonal Latin squares.
summary: 绝对最大纠缠态代表了多部分纠缠的高度约束形式，在量子信息论中发挥着重要作用。我们研究了局域维度 $d>2$ 的四方系统的较弱形式的纠缠均匀性，它要求三个平衡二分具有相等但不一定最大的线性熵。我们引入了一个线性映射$\Xi$，它在重新洗牌和部分转置下强制熵的精确相等。该变换作为迭代平均过程的渐近极限而出现，并允许根据张量指数的排列进行群论描述。对于 Haar 随机单一输入，数值模拟支持的主导矩分析可以预测高度纠缠的输出，其公共熵随着局部维度的增长而接近最大值。我们描述了该映射的代数结构、不动点和渐近行为及其与二酉矩阵和正交拉丁方的关系。

title: Path integral approach to the truncated Wigner approximation of driven-dissipative spins
abstract: Phase-space approaches such as the truncated Wigner approximation (TWA) provide an efficient semiclassical framework for performing approximate simulations of the dynamics of open quantum many-body systems outside the reach of exact numerical methods but beyond the mean-field level. For bosonic systems, TWA is known to be equivalent to a Keldysh path-integral formulation truncated at second order in the so-called quantum fluctuations. This semiclassical approach provides an alternative transparent route towards approximate stochastic equations of motion, which can be efficiently solved. Here we establish the corresponding path-integral formulation for interacting open spin-$1/2$ systems using the continuous $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ phase space. We show, in particular, that a consistent treatment of dissipation requires correctly mapping operator products onto the curved spin phase space, leading to stochastic equations that coincide with those obtained from the continuous TWA formulation and thus reproduce the exact dynamics of a single dissipative spin. Our results provide a unified field-theoretic foundation for the TWA to dissipative spin dynamics and offer a systematic starting point for extensions beyond the semiclassical approximation.
summary:
截断维格纳近似（TWA）等相空间方法提供了一种有效的半经典框架，用于对开放量子多体系统的动力学进行近似模拟，超出了精确数值方法的范围，但超出了平均场水平。对于玻色子系统，TWA 相当于所谓量子涨落中二阶截断的凯尔迪什路径积分公式。这种半经典方法为近似随机运动方程提供了一种替代的透明途径，可以有效地求解该方程。在这里，我们使用连续的 $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ 相空间建立了相互作用的开放自旋 $1/2$ 系统的相应路径积分公式。我们特别表明，一致的耗散处理需要将算子乘积正确映射到弯曲的自旋相空间上，从而产生与从连续 TWA 公式中获得的随机方程一致的随机方程，从而再现单个耗散自旋的精确动力学。

我们的结果为 TWA 的耗散自旋动力学提供了统一的场论基础，并为超越半经典近似的扩展提供了系统的起点。
